overall_description: A two-tier lazy Susan with a fixed central post and two separate rotating shelves. Each circular shelf is carried by its own bearing collar around the post, so the upper and lower tiers can move independently. The lower shelf rotates on one vertical revolute axis around the post, and the upper shelf rotates on a second vertical revolute axis on its own collar.
